verified_observations: The official ORGI NADA catalogue identifies LSI_JHARKHAND, the title, producer, publication date, and downloadable filename LSI_JHARKHAND.pdf.
The web-indexed representation of the official PDF exposes a Mundari section and shows printed page marker [278] associated with Mundari location/family material.
The indexed extraction is useful as a locator lead but is not treated as a page-image inspection or authoritative OCR verification.
